title: Operations & recovery
pendingPayment: Paid without fulfillment for over 5 minutes
backupScope: Backs up the panel database only. Back up remote engines, servers and the encryption master key separately. Restrict access to backup files.
auditHint: Export action timestamps, actors and results. Credentials and email links are excluded.
recoveryHint: Back up before upgrading, check readiness before switching traffic, and preserve the current database when rolling back code to avoid losing recent payments.
